UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated AOS Tools user profile and role metadata.

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile.

role.description: User access tier within AOS Tools.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest login.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

UserSecurityConfig.title: UserSecurityConfig
UserSecurityConfig.description: Private per-user tool locking preferences, hashed PIN, and auto-lock settings.

ownerId.description: Owner UID matching Firebase Auth UID.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 salted hash of operator security PIN (empty string when disabled).

pinEnabled.description: Whether PIN protection is enabled for locked tools.

requireAuthForProTools.description: Whether high-tier tools require active Google authentication.

autoLockMinutes.description: Inactivity auto-lock duration in minutes (0 disables auto-lock).

lockedToolIds.description: Bounded list of tool IDs currently locked by the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest security config update.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores verified user profile records strictly accessible only to the profile owner or admins.

/users/{userId}/private/{configId}.description: Isolated private security preferences and tool lock configurations owned by the user.
